description: Submit the buyer-signed agreement proposal for a NEGOTIATING deal (buyer-only): the artifact JSON {content, signatures:[one buyer signature]} base64-encoded. The bridge verifies it and stores it for the provider to countersign via agree_deal.

artifact_b64.description: base64-std of the deal-artifact JSON {content, signatures:[{signer, jws}]} carrying EXACTLY ONE signature — the buyer's ES256 JWS over the JCS-canonical content. The bridge verifies the signature, the content-vs-deal binding and freshness before storing it as the deal's agreement_proposal

deal_id.description: the NEGOTIATING deal to propose the agreement for; caller must be the deal's buyer

name: propose_agreement
